title: Development and Validation of a Mixture-of-Experts-Based Model for Postoperative In-Hospital Mortality Risk Assessment: Multicenter Retrospective Study.
summary: MoE mortality model separates surgical risk across two databases; final and first-preprint evidence support the limited result, with calibration caveats. Four LSTM-expert MoE evaluated on INSPIRE and HUAXI cohorts; cross-database discrimination reported, with calibration limitations explicitly noted.
